name: harness-bench-oracles
description: Runtime deps for oracle.mjs scripts (bench/fixtures/**/oracle.mjs, bench/fixtures/_lib/browserOracle.mjs). Node resolves their bare `vite`/`playwright`/`@vitejs/plugin-react` imports by walking up from the importing file to the nearest ancestor node_modules — this package.json/install is that ancestor, it's not meant to be run as its own app.
